semantics.identity_rule: Logical artifact identity is separate from hash unless explicitly content-addressed.
semantics.equality_rule: Equal hash proves equal hashed bytes under the declared algorithm/profile, not equivalent authority/ownership.
semantics.mismatch_rule: Hash mismatch hard-fails integrity-required import/install/certification path.
semantics.authority_rule: Valid hash grants no install/runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.
